stem:
This question has two parts. First, answer Part A. Then answer Part B.

Part A
What is the central idea of the article?

options.label: A
options.text: Salamanders play an important role in their environment.

options.label: B
options.text: Scientists study how different salamanders behave.

options.label: C
options.text: Salamanders need to live in certain temperatures.

options.label: D
options.text: People should visit the salamanders that live in aquifers.

notes: The problem includes Part B, but only Part A was extracted as one problem per user instruction.
